The lagoon escrow holds each stake, the cipher settlement releases it, and the trellis audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 22% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
